name: Cesare Attolini
why: Neapolitan tailoring from the family credited with the unpadded Neapolitan shoulder.
origin: Vincenzo Attolini developed the soft shoulder at Rubinacci in the 1930s; the house carries his son's name.

onething.n: via Neiman Marcus — a live cashmere jacket; the house names no products, so the piece is the category

notes.wool: the soft shoulder its family invented
notes.ital: Naples, and the family is widely credited with the modern soft jacket — the unpadded shoulder and the light canvas that let a jacket move with a body rather than around it.
notes.boat: Neapolitan soft tailoring on the Amalfi register, where the coast and the tailoring tradition are the same geography.
